The Angel of Valhalla is a legendary white chocobo within the Wildlands in Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII. It features in local legends, and is said to herald the end of the world.

page.overview:
Who is Angel of Valhalla?

Angel of Valhalla is a white chocobo in Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII that appears as an uncontrollable guest character on the Wildlands as part of the main quest there. Once recruited, Lightning can ride him across most of the overworld in the Wildlands, and he will fight alongside her in battle. He is not particularly strong, but helps Lightning along by healing and buffing her.

Lightning can ride the Angel of Valhalla by pressing / when next to him, and the same button is also used for dismounting. The Angel of Valhalla runs the same speed Lightning dashes, but riding will not deplete the action gauge. He jumps with / and pecks enemies with /. Once the Angel can glide, the player must hold / after jumping to glide through the air. Gliding is needed to reach the Temple of the Goddess from Poltae, and also to reach some treasure chests that are off the beaten path. When fully healed, the Angel can perform a three-hit combo to strike enemies just as Lightning can.

Lightning automatically climbs off her steed when talking to certain people or during other events. The player can name the white chocobo in the original console releases, although no one outside the party will refer to him by that name. In the PC version, it is impossible to change the chocobo's name.

Within the Wildlands, the Angel is Lightning's loyal companion. If Lightning explores an area on foot and falls to an area where she would not be able to return to the Angel, the bird will return to Lightning on his own. If Lightning leaves the Wildlands and returns later in a different area of the Wildlands, the Angel will shortly appear in that area, ready for Lightning to ride again.
